annotations.title: Book a boat transfer (returns a payment link)

description: Creates a booking for one transfer that Phi Phi Paradise organizes, listed by search_transfers, and returns its reference and a secure payment page. Partner departures listed with a trip_id: pass trip_id. Lines listed with a 12Go price are booked on 12Go, not here. Our own boat departures: pass from, to, type, departure_time and company exactly as listed. Requires traveller_confirmed: true, set once the traveller has approved the route, date, time, passengers and total. Transfers are paid online in full; the seat is secured only when paid.

company.description: Operator exactly as listed by search_transfers (our own departures).

confirm_duplicate.description: Only true if the traveller explicitly wants a SECOND identical booking after an ALREADY BOOKED answer.

departure_time.description: HH:MM exactly as listed by search_transfers (our own departures).

hotel_pickup.description: Only for departures listed 'hotel pickup on request, +100 THB/person'.

language.description: Traveller language code (en, fr, de, es, zh...). Sets the emails and the payment page language.

pickup_time.description: Private taxi / van / boat (no fixed time): pickup time HH:MM chosen by the traveller.

traveller_confirmed.description: true once the traveller has approved the restated product, date, party, total and payment.

traveller_email.description: Email: receives the confirmation and e-ticket after payment.

traveller_name.description: Full name of the lead traveller.

traveller_phone.description: WhatsApp number with country code (e.g. +33612345678). Strongly recommended: the local team uses it on the day.

trip_id.description: trip_id of a departure listed by search_transfers.

name: book_transfer
title: Book a boat transfer (returns a payment link)
